content: दैवत {%a.%} (-ती|{%f.%}) [देवता-अण्] .²1 Divine. .²2 (At the end of an <ab>adj. comp.</ab>) Honouring or worshipping as oneʼs deity, as in सूर्यदैवता जनाः .{@-तम्@} A god, deity, divinity; मृदं गां दैवतं विप्रं घृतं मधु चतुष्पथं प्रदक्षिणानि कुर्वीत <ls>Ms. 4. 39</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 4.">153</ls>; <ls>U. 4. 4</ls>; <ls>Amaru. 3</ls>; हन्त प्रिया दैवतमस्य देवी <ls>Bhāg. 4. 4. 28</ls>. .²2 A number of gods, the whole class of gods; <ls>Ve. 2</ls>. .²3 An idol. (The word is said to be {%m.%} also, but is rarely used in that gender. Mammaṭa notices it as a fault called अप्रयुक्तत्व; see अप्रयुक्त). .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of the third Kāṇḍa of Yāskas Nirukta.
